notes.title: Update ver.1.1.0
notes.content:
[b]The following updates have been implemented:
[/b]
Changes:
1.Fixed typos (Japanese and Simplified Chinese).
2.Fixed an issue where skipping could not be canceled in some scenes.
3.Fixed an issue where save data would get corrupted (unable to load) when saving in certain scenes.
*If your save data has already been corrupted, we sincerely apologize, and kindly ask you to use a different save file.

Please use the update feature to apply the changes.
We apologize for the inconvenience and the time it took to correct the problem.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
We have fixed a bug that prevented some illustrations
from being displayed in the Gallery in English and Simplified Chinese.
Please use the update function.

We apologize for any concerns.

notes.title: About the Gallery bug
notes.content:
We have confirmed a bug that prevents some illustrations 
from being displayed in Gallery mode in English and Simplified Chinese.

We are currently working on this issue and will inform you as soon as it is completed.
We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

*If you read from start to finish in Japanese, 
the Gallery illustrations will display correctly when you switch to another language

notes.title: System Guide -Text Window-
notes.content:
In this work, the color of the text window
changes depending on the scenes.

If you have difficulty reading the text, 
you can set the window color to black by selecting ON 
“Default Text Window Color” in “Settings”.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45103765/04480875252acd16bc52befa41f9332c92edc276.png[/img]

Please try it.

*The Demo version does not have this feature.
